title: Grateful Dead Live at Dream Bowl on 1969-02-22

ai_review.summary: A solid SBD capture of the legendary Feb‑22 1969 Vallejo show – crystal‑clear enough to hear a blazing Dark Star, The Eleven and Lovelight despite occasional muffling.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised as one of the band’s peak psychedelic outings, highlighted by an acoustic‑to‑electric segue into a soaring Dark Star, a marathon Eleven, and a beautifully voiced Lovelight.  Most listeners find the soundboard (SBD) source clean and well‑balanced, though a few note slight muddiness or brief distortion during Dark Star.  Overall the set flows seamlessly with high energy throughout both sets.

ai_rating.rationale: Average user rating is 4.63/5 across 35 reviews; the vast majority rave about the musical performance and deem the recording good enough for repeated listening, with only a handful of minor complaints.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear SBD capture with balanced mix; some reviewers mention slight muffling or brief distortion in Dark Star, but overall the sound is considered very listenable and well‑balanced for a 1969 source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Seamless acoustic‑to‑electric transition into Dark Star, a powerful first set that builds into an ecstatic second set; high‑energy flow with strong segues and minimal dead time.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly described as ‘possessed’, delivering fluid leads, flawless tone and intense, soaring guitar work throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass noted as solid (some describe it as a bit bass‑heavy), providing a sturdy foundation for the improvisations.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey’s percussion praised for precision, especially during the climax of The Eleven.
